t.rel: It fought a war with Serbia as it won independence from Yugoslavia in the 1990s. It joined the euro and the Schengen area in 2023.
t.know: The necktie is said to have come from the scarves of Croatian soldiers.
t.etext: Adriatic tourism holds up much of the economy, along with shipbuilding and food. It started using the euro in 2023.
